task: KeyedExecutor: serial per key, parallel across keys, on a supplied Executor
reasoning_summary: Per-key FIFO queues under one lock; each key has at most one scheduled turn on the delegate, which re-submits itself after every task for fairness, and keys are removed when drained. Tests were written first (ordering, parallelism, failure, cancellation, shutdown, rejection rollback, fairness on a single gated worker, stress with plain counters) and passed on the first attempt, repeated 7 times.
